Frank had the paper open at the table when she came in. He didn't look up. The kettle was already cool — Diana's pour, an hour ago, before she'd gone out to the garden. Coffee bitter from sitting since five-thirty.

Frank: Morning.
Sit at the table.

Frank's Office



The door stays closed when Frank isn't in it. Metal filing cabinets older than the house. A desk facing the window so he can see the yard while working. Paper everywhere — neat piles, but piles.
